title: Heroes of Might and Magic V (H5_Game.exe)
notes: Played for 3 min through Highball. Graphics display, shadows, etc. load well. Open to resolution of the occasional frame drops. Required using wined3d to load profiles, opening profiles>default_profile>user_a2.cfg and modifying 'setvar gfx_fullscreen' to 0 for windowed mode. After switching to dxvk, works alright.
issues: Frame drops for 1s upon complex environment interaction, not more often than 1/min
